title: The White Sweet Pea Gently Swaying

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—The snow princesses are in full bloom.
Fufu, a stunning pure white. The little blossoms gather together like round pompoms.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It should be about time for the pansies to bloom, too, but—
Let's move them to a sunnier spot.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Watering's done. Now, for the flowers to decorate the classroom...
Could you spare just some roses for me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And then—oh my. The sweet peas are already blooming.
Pairing them together will make it quite gorgeous. For the color... perhaps white would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, how lovely. I hope everyone showers you with lots of affection.
—Ah. Sparkling in the morning sun...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: A delicate, golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The elegance of roses paired with the ruffled frills of sweet peas.
Gather distinct individualities and bring them into harmony—and voila, a cheerful, dancing bouquet is born.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Both flowers and races... when their respective colors blend in harmony, they shine all the brighter.
That special kind of beauty... is what I love.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm-mm~♪ The mock race we've been waiting for is finally here!
I can't wait for our turn!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan, skipping around like that...
aren't you going to tire yourself out before the race?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, it's my personal rule!
Whenever I'm itching to run, I skip!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa, someone's super fired up~!
Still, Maru-chan and Love-chan went through secret special training too, you know!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right~?♪ Gran-chan isn't the only one
who was looking forward to today's mock race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone is in top form, even for a mock race.
L-Let's do our best so we don't get swallowed up...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I will give it everything I have.
Let us both have a wonderful run.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Group D, you're up next!
...Alright, all runners in the gate!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—I managed to secure a forward position.
Chrono-san is nearby—and Loves-san and the others are at the rear.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The pace is slightly brisk. At this rate, the final stretch will be tough.
I must not get swept along; I have to maintain my own pace—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I won't let you dictate the pace. I'll mark you and apply pressure...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maru-chan is taking the inside lane.
—Then I'll take the outside!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(From both flanks—! Ah... the front is closing up fast.
Forcing my way through there would be... then, to the outside—)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even from way outside, I can still overtake you!!
Hyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I can't get to the outside either—all I can do is wait for an opening up front...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ————, —gh, right now! Hyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-san, the moment a gap for one opens up, you must strike immediately.
You need the drive to carve out your own space! That mindset is what leads to victory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Yes... Thank you very much for your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Bouquet-san, I'm sorry...
Did I... put too much pressure on you...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please don't apologize, it wasn't you! It's entirely an issue with my own mindset—
The thought crossed my mind that cutting in might cause trouble for everyone...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're always so considerate. That's very like you, Bouquet-chan, but...
Everyone's used to it. With a gap like that, people expect others to push through!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
L-Love-chan is right...!
Besides, racing... competitions are just like that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you both for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Fiercely contesting to seize victory.
Pushing through gaps to carve out a path—that, too, is part of competition.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (And yet—I still hesitate...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. Um, Trainers,
would it be alright if I changed the water for the flowers?
choice_data_list: Ah, it's you. Thank you, as always!
Ah, it's you. Thank you, as always!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I'm simply sharing some of the flowers from the classroom
with the Trainers' lounge—um, you're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, the roses I brought the day before yesterday are still blooming beautifully.
Pairing them with the flowers I brought today—putting the red one in the center might be nice.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—A red rose. Passionate, just like Loves-san.
It commands such presence, yet when bound with other blossoms—it blends in exquisite harmony.)

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
Go, Curren-chan, do your best~! Wow, she's so fast...!
Keep going, keep going, just a little more...! —Yay, she won!

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Curren-chan and everyone else are shining so brightly.
In a race, everyone comes together as one—just like a bouquet of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Young Bouquet
text_block_list.text: How wonderful... I want to become part of the bouquet with them too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Each runner's feelings clash, giving birth to the race's "harmony."
Enchanted by the harmony Curren-chan and the others displayed—I began running myself.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(And yet—I cannot push myself forward. Unable to aggressively chase victory...
Perhaps I am merely disrupting the "harmony" of the race...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Unable to answer with the same passion. Creating discord.
............Perhaps I ought to quit—)
choice_data_list: Is something wrong? You seem lost in thought... Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-I'm so sorry! I am... quite alright—
I will arrange the flowers right away! —And go change the water too!
choice_data_list: Um... before that. Here, have some coffee.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Coffee, and even tea snacks.
Is it truly alright for me to accept so much?
choice_data_list: Your flowers bring me so much comfort, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so glad... Trainer-san always thanks me.
Not only noticing the flowers—but saying they brought comfort...)
choice_data_list: Is that a sweet pea? It's lovely and vibrant.
Is that a sweet pea? It's lovely and vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is. The fluttering petals look just like frills, don't they?
Fufufu, so vibrant and charming.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's why they are so easy to use in floral arrangements.
Adding sweet peas gives it movement and instantly brightens the whole piece.
choice_data_list: It looks like your spirits have brightened up too.
It looks like your spirits have brightened up too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Did they speak to me because they saw I was troubled?
Could it be—even this coffee...?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it is all thanks to the flowers and this coffee.
It's so warm—it has softened my heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry, got a minute?
There's a favor I'd like to ask—
